title: Такой же или не такой
description: Такой же или не такой: применяем правило в самостоятельных ситуациях, работаем со словарём и читаем авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Выражать равенство признака через as ... as
Выражать неравенство через not as ... as
notes: Для равенства: This room is as large as that one. Между as ставится исходная форма прилагательного.
Not as expensive as означает меньшую стоимость, а не большую.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The two rooms have the same size. This room is ___ large as that one.
exercises.explanation: Равенство выражается as large as, без сравнительной степени.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение словом из пары: expensiver / expensive.

public_payload.sentence: This bag is as ___ as mine; they cost the same.

exercises.editorial_answer: This bag is as expensive as mine; they cost the same.
exercises.explanation: В as ... as нужна исходная форма expensive.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Синяя комната не такая большая, как зелёная.»
exercises.editorial_answer: The blue room is not as large as the green room.
exercises.explanation: Not as large as означает меньший размер синей комнаты.

exercises.prompt: Исправь указанную конструкцию, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: This train is as faster as the other one.

accepted: This train is as fast as the other one.

exercises.reference_answer: This train is as fast as the other one.
exercises.incorrect_answer: This train is as faster as the other one.
exercises.editorial_answer: This train is as fast as the other one.
exercises.explanation: Между as используется fast, а не faster.

public_payload.passage: Two friends are choosing a room for a study group. The blue room is not as large as the green room, but it is as quiet. Both rooms cost the same for an hour. They choose the green room because eight people are coming and they need more space.

exercises.explanation: As quiet и cost the same указывают на тишину и цену.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова урока с переводом в указанном контексте.
exercises.editorial_answer: equal — равный; spacious — просторный; expensive — дорогой; similar — похожий
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: equal — равный; spacious — просторный; expensive — дорогой; similar — похожий.

public_payload.passage: Two friends are choosing a room for a study group. The blue room is not as large as the green room, but it is as quiet. Both rooms cost the same for an hour. They choose the green room because eight people are coming and they need more space.

options.label: The blue room is too noisy to use.
It has more space for eight people.
It is cheaper for an hour.

exercises.editorial_answer: It has more space for eight people.
exercises.explanation: Решающим фактором была вместимость, не цена и не шум.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Is the new chair more expensive?

options.label: No, it is as more expensive as the old one.
No, it is than expensive as the old one.
No, it is as expensive as the old one.

exercises.editorial_answer: No, it is as expensive as the old one.
exercises.explanation: As expensive as описывает одинаковую цену.

public_payload.sentence: These two designs are not identical, but they look ___.

exercises.explanation: Similar означает похожие, не обязательно полностью одинаковые.
